notes.title: 0.6d.277 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone in this Cruel Galaxy!

0.6d is Live now with torturing mechanics and bugfixes.

Bug Fixes

 To prevent you from glitches with unlucky screen sizes, we limit you to use only 16x9 for a while.
 Hull Breach event bug fixed again (third time is a bless).
 Fixed a bug when Loot All button didnt recounted the wreckage cost, so you got more Parts than intended.


Animations

 Main menu reworked. Just take a look, now it's full 3D.


Gameplay Changes

 Discordia Destroyes spaceship dont get any modules except for Engine on start of new game. Get a recipes first!
 You cannot re-use enemy crew anymore. Upon looting enemy officers, they become Captives.
 However, now you can Interrogate Captives, getting some resources (events would be added later).
 Officers now limited on each spaceship class to 1/2/3 maximum (3 on Destroyers, and special module would be added later).


Quality Improvements

 When trying to move spaceship without key modules into Vanguard, you will recieve a notification about that decision.

notes.title: 0.6b Update is live with a lot of quality of life improvements.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone in this Cruel Galaxy!

0.6b Update is live with a lot of quality of life improvements.
If you have tested our latest-test build, dont forget to discard it and swap to default build.

Freebies

New Virgin Silver paint style available for all players who have launched game after release.


Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug allowing ally ship to move in enemy occupied tile.
Fixed a bug when some of Spaceship or Modules bars was not scrolling the way they must.
Fixed bug when main menu Parallax effect goes on a vacation.
Fixed bug when yo ustill see pop-ups, hovers and ship UI above overlay (Victory or Journal)
Fixed a bug hiding HP bar in turn order bar.


Animations

Added on-hit animations for shooting action (different for each ship model).
Added ship destruction animation
Added ship warp-retreat animation (only for Black Knights)


Gameplay Changes

Easy mode! Black Knights faction now have ability to restore their ships even after they lose a battle. The ship must not be destroyed completely, of course.
Chance to completely lose allied ship reduced by 50%.
Restored trophy ships now got Virgin Silver painting by default.


Quality Improvements

Each module type now have 3 different pictures instead of one (one for each size). 12 images added in total.
All ingame graphics sized up to 1920x1080.
All ingame UI size reduced by about 25%.
All spaceships now auto-sort by power rating.
All modules now auto-sort by type, and after that, by power rating.
Now you can see damaged and destroyed modules by yellow and red overlay in combat, respectively.
Un-selected and active module borders have been redrawed accordingly.
In Fleet management screen, you now see if there more modules or spaceships to scroll.
Hovering messages now only contains grey and white colors for text.
Some buttons have been moved to more appropriate places.
Skip button in dialogs now placed after Next.

notes.title: Discordia 0.5a Minor Update
notes.notes:
We have noticed that game is crushing as soon every second combat starts, and hunting this bug at the moment. Thank you for patience!

Also for this moment few improvements have been made:

 Now you can step BACK in dialogs if you missed something.
 Now you can SKIP dialogs and tutorial until the very end of story arc (or to the nearest choice).
 Background in combat now totally infinite (you cannot see the edge anymore).
 Bug fixed: Tutorial now can be replayed instead of only showing one screen of text.
 Character images quality have been slightly improved, excluding extra compression.
 Spaceship attack now make more random scatter of laser impulses than before (we still dont want you to know if you missed or not before damage deducted).
 Spaceships now have rotation animation when moving, so it less awkward than before.


Thank you for staying in touch, and please send your feedback to the community page.

Yours truly,
Fatal Error Games

notes.title: RELEASE and Update 5 patchnotes
notes.notes:
The game would be available starting from 12 am PST (GMT 17:00). We are still fixing some issues, and our lead developer hit 30th birthday today and want to celebrate both events... Whatever. Here is patch notes:

New Features
* First part of tutorial added to the game (however, it is not so smooth yet, we are working on it). 
* You can skip tutorial if you want and play in free mode from start.
* First part of story and characters added to the game.
* You cannot skip story yet (would be added in hotfix in a few days).
* Journal added, allowing to re-read every story and tutorial sequence again (without consequences).

Supporters DLC 1
* Added both to Steam and in game. It can be enabled/disabled in main menu by clicking on it (top-right on screen).
* Name of spaceship now can be visible on Fitting screen
* DLC Feature: You can rename your spaceships and change color up to 7 different color schemes.
* Free Feature: You can change color of your spaceships between two main color schemes (Black Knights and UN Government).

Bug Fixes
* Final boss is not white anymore.
* Hull Breach event is not infinite anymore (write us if you still see this bug, please)

Quality Improvements
* After 100% game completion there is now separate Signature for a boss fight.
* All clickable buttons are now transparent 
* Most of UI elements become more compact and readable.

notes.title: Update 0.4 - Crafting, Looting and Fitting
notes.notes:
Hello everyone who is subscribed, or just want to know is the game alive. Yep it is!

Here are some hot new features in the gameplay we are ready to announce (already on BETA-test):
(and if you are eager to join the beta test - write us to fatalerrormobile@gmail.com or in our Discord Server. Please mention "Discordia Beta Test".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37769442/e66450dcda86a57ff6531ce4a6ae2d86c20e3394.png

New Feature - Modular Damage and Repair System:
* From now on every module have 15-25% chance to be damaged on receiving structural damage
* If module was already damaged before, it would be destroyed instead
* Modules can be repaired in combat with Order Actions (pink icon), generated by Officers
* Both Damaged and destroyed modules cannot be used in any way
* Module status is reflected both with its name color and on ship StatusBoard (with yellow and red dots)
* Repairing hull only gives 1 point of hull
* Destroyed ship have 50% chance of being destroyed, and if not, all modules have additional damage check
* All destroyed modules and ships are wiped out from loot after battle ends, while damaged repairs for free
* Enemy AI adjusted so, they can repair modules

New Feature - Items and Loot management System:
* Now you can freely customize your ship with modules and crew between jumps
* Each module have different Node size, from zero on crew to 9 on Destroyer turret
* Ships can have unlimited number of same type modules, but only one turret and engine can be active at the moment
* Ships now have Node limit, but all ships start with some free Nodes. Enjoy.
* Different modules have different effects on different ship Ranks.
* You can move modules from Loot section and ship fitting to storage, and storage is unlimited size (come on, we're not Stoneshard)
* Loot All Modules button added as well

New Feature - Craft, Decompose and Research
* Each module now have Scheme to obtain by decomposing it - either from Storage or from Loot screen
* After obtaining Scheme you need to spend Ideas to research it
* After researching Scheme you can Craft as many modules as you wish with it
* Salvaging a ship automatically creates all linked Schemes

Bug Fixes
* Finally fixed combat bug with enemy Freeze (along with game)

Balance Changes
* New modules line - Reactor XS/S/M, giving additional Energy to ship. Without Reactor ship still generate one energy
* Destroyers now have two Officers by default (hello Spock)
* Ship HP now separated for Hull Point (gray) and Structure Points (red). Hull points are repaired automatically after combat, while structure requires Parts for repair. Hull also can be repaired during combat with Repair action
* Each module and ship now have separate power rating to reflect customization system
* All costs and power ratings was moderately changed to balance economics and match-making
* Enemy power rating now scales from 50-70% of your vanguard as start of campaign to 100-120% in the endgame. Learn before losing, dear players
* Every non-combat Event gives 5 Ideas, every Combat gives 1 Merits
* Average to-hit reduced from 80% to 75% to create 95% cap for XS Turret
* Base damage now more clustered (dice sides reduced for all turrets)

Quality Improvements - Warp in and Victory Screen
* Ships now warp in smoothly
* Also ships now move with dynamic speed
* You can notice new waves of enemies coming as well
* After last ally or enemy is destroyed, Victory Screen show up, with result of damage done to all ships

Other Quality Improvements
* Flags on ship interface now have stars to reflect ship rank (three at the moment)
* Action Point icons changed to flat circles
* Fitting screen redesigned to reflect current ship in selection
* StatusBoard now reflects "No Weapon" Status if you cannot shoot to enemy on that cause
* Mission now have objective on Turn Section
* Tooltips updated for all new features added
* Camera movement animation added to lessen headache
* Modules now have XS/S/M names instead of ranks
* Studio logo now much darker

Stay in touch and be ready for release - it is really 3 weeks to go, just like that.

Thank you for support
Fatal Error Games

notes.title: Dev Blog #1: Release Date and Roadmap
notes.notes:
Dear players, I think you have already added the game to wishlist and subscribed for news. Here is our first Dev Post about further plans.

Why Free? Why DLC?
As you have noticed, Discordia would be Free signle-player game without in game currency. Why that? Because we don't want the game price to affect you experience within. That's why we would release Cosmetics DLC along. If you really care about making this game a better place - you would be able to support Devs with this optional piece of cosmetics. Price of DLC would be around 5$, maybe less.

When do you release?
At the moment we are passing Steam moderation of in-game content, and if we pass successfully, Release Date would be 30 June, 2020. There is a small chance that release would be postponed, but it will not affect Roadmap and Features scope.

Features? What do you have in mind?
Ok, here is a short-list of updates for 2020:

Before Release:

 Update 3 Scouting and Balance (27 May 2020)
 Update 4 Craft, Repair and Loot (10 June 2020)
 Update 5 Story Mode and Tutorial (24 June 2020)


Release 30 June (planned)

 DLC: Cosmetics (Support Devs #1)


After Release:

 Update 6 Sounds & Animations
 Update 7 New Tactics & Skills
 Update 8 Mission Types & AI Improve
 DLC: New Campaign (Content DLC #1)


What's now?
If you are eager to help us right in the moment, you can participate in Closed Beta testing, by contacting us in Discord Server or by email (place "Discordia beta test" in subject): fatalerrormobile@gmail.com

Anyway, stay in touch, and ask questions in our Steam Community Page. We would keep you posted with Dev blog every two weeks, or so.

Yours truly
Fatal Error Games team.

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are glad to announce that from now on we can send Closed beta-test key to those who want to participate in game polishing.
If you are interested, send email to fatalerrormobile@gmail.com with subject "Discordia Beta test". If you have any ideas how to highlight the game on the Web, feel free to share in our Discord Server.

Now, lets look closer to features added in this major update:

Fixed errors:
* Combat event about Hull breach now repairs Hull as meant to
* Fleet management scroll issues fixed (Vanguard and Reserve lists)
* Enemy power now scales not only from number of ships, but from their rating

New features:
* Scouting system - before jump now you can choose one path of many with different singatures, and those provide more clear knowledge about enemy threat.
* Modules rework - now each module provides list of actions from activation types to disable and repair actions.
* Billboards rework - every ship focused in combat now have proper information floating above, like ally/enemy flag, turns to act, and most wanted, to-hit-chance.

Balance and quality issues:
* Game now autosaves before and after each jump, with scouted signatures as well.
* Signatures now have only three types of enemy chances: 0%, 50%, 100%.
* Spaceship stats rebalanced to reduce "1v1 Corvette kills Destroyer" duels chances.
* Spaceships now spawn near edge of map and with one energy on first turn.
* New spaceship thumbs for every available combination in game at the moment
* Navigation screen now shows Vanguard Power and provide a button to return in Fleet Management screen
* Space button in combat = skip turn

And much more, full list of fixes are available to our beta testers, thank you!
Stay in touch and tell your friends about upcoming release!
